name: Mammal
description: Warm blooded, hairy creatures. Often social.

name: Bird
description: Warm, feathered creatures. Usually capable of flight.

name: Reptile
description: Cold, scaly creatures with limited empathic faculties.

name: Amphibian
description: Creatures which transition from water to land at different phases of their lifecycle.

name: Fish
description: Creatures with gills and scales, native to lakes, rivers, the depths of the sea and so forth.

name: Insect
description: Creatures possessing an exoskeleton and jointed limbs, such as insects, spiders, and crustaceans.

name: Mollusk
description: Creatures with soft, slimy flesh, such as octopi and snails. Often intelligent.

name: Blob
description: Various amorphous or gelatinous entities colloquially known as slimes, oozes, or blobs.

name: Plant
description: Photosynthetic entities possessing biological and morphological similarities to plants.

name: Zombie
description: Raised dead which feed on dead and decaying corpses. Extremely unpredictable.

name: Vampire
description: Immortal undead which feed exclusively on the blood of the living.

name: Ghost
description: Spirits of the recently departed, which yet possess the energy required to manifest in the physical.

name: Demon
description: Cursed spirits who rebelled against their maker. Now confined to the hells, where their power cannot alleviate their suffering. Too arrogant to seek mercy or forgiveness, they instead strive to bring mortals to subjugation, corruption, and torment.

name: Dragon
description: Ferocious beings forged in the primordial fires. They may take any form, but find that of the dragon most befitting their immense power. Obsessed with hierarchy, they fight constantly amongst their own kind. They largely keep to their own, but occasionally take an interest in mortal affairs.

name: Fey
description: Playful and mischievous spirits of nature and the wilds, who cannot be tamed. They have acquired a negative reputation, but in truth they only lash out against mortals who encroach upon the forests and jungles of the world.

name: Angel
description: Spirits of light who joyfully serve the divine Source.

name: Construct
description: Conglomerations of non-living components animated by lesser spirits. Often assembled by skilled mortal mages.

name: Mimic
description: Any of several entities which take the form of physical objects. Immensely dangerous.
